name: uberllm
description: UberLLM MCP server (make images and videos, price requests, list models, read your balance) and a skill for setting up UberLLM's OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API.

interface.shortDescription: Images, video and AI models from one API key
interface.longDescription: Make images and videos, price a request before you spend, list chat, image, video and music models with live prices, and read your balance through UberLLM's hosted MCP server. The bundled skill sets up UberLLM's OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API in Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and SDKs. A request costs what its provider charged; no UberLLM fee on requests.
defaultPrompt: Use UberLLM to list the cheapest video models and their price per second.
Use UberLLM to quote, then make, a 5-second video of a red bicycle.
Use UberLLM to check my balance.
